pass_a.rule: >=2 cities with n>=200 and lead-1 hit >= 0.47

pass_b.rule: >=2 cities lead-0 hit >= 0.55 AND study-2 morning asks <= 60c
pass_b.note: ask condition filled in by run_timing.py

pass_a2.rule: >=2 cities with n>=200 and 840-day formula d1 hit_est >= 0.47 (spec addendum 6)

replay.what: held-out accuracy proof: beliefs frozen 2026-06-15, replayed to 2026-07-20 on real candle asks
replay.note: all 3 cities non-negative; picked entries 5-13pp overconfident (winner's curse), fix registered for G1; not significant at n=50, verdict clock starts at G1

d1_counted_clock.rule: >=3 cities with >=5 settled entries and positive net taker P&L

d2_shrink.rule: adopt best w only if >=2% relative Brier gain vs w=1.0

d3_honesty.rule: no counted clock if adopted model Brier worse than market mid

d4_exit_95.rule: ride bids >=95c if holding beat selling, min 5

d5_floor.rule: raise floor to 15c if sub-15c entries net negative, min 10

d6_mornings.rule: close morning window if d0 entries net negative, min 8

d7_bench.rule: bench city: >=6 settled, negative P&L, negative mean CLV

d8_afternoon_meter.rule: report always; armable only if positive with n>=50, owner call
